\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Volume of balls in Euclidean space] 1. ch10:10-5↗ prob:volume-formula-spheres

For $r > 0$, let $B_r(0)$ denote the ball of radius $r$ in Euclidean space $(\mathbb {R}^n, \tilde{g})$, $n \geq 1$. Prove that \[ \operatorname {Vol}(B_r(0)) = \frac{1}{n} a_{n-1} r^n, \] with $a_{n-1}$ as in Problem 10-4. \end{exercise}
